quest.title: Poems Dedicated to the Wind
quest.description: The winds of Mondstadt are leisurely as ever. Enjoy the gentle breeze as you go along.

talks.objective: Go to the Angel's Share to look for help
Go look around the Cathedral for Barbara
Return to the Cathedral plaza and have a discussion with everyone

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...Kaeya is a wily character, but a free wine is always the most delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, it's fine. I mean, the church's choral hymns aren't exactly my strong suit, what with all the finicky formalities and so on... but as long as there is love for music in the air, I'm sure I'll be able to help.

choices.text: It sounds like it'll actually take a lot of work...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hey, if I'm happy, and Sister Grace is happy, and the audience is happy... that's a great thing, isn't it?

choices.text: You're not just doing it for the wine?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Got it! With this melody, it'll be much more expressive...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Okay everyone, write your ideas down once you've got something, and then we'll open it up for a group discussion!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I think the song should express the joy of being together with family.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Should I write about Fish Head Soup, or Liyue Grilled Fish...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Thank you both so much! Having some expert guidance will definitely be a great help.

dialogues.speaker: Melker
dialogues.text: Hmm, what should I sing about...

dialogues.speaker: Artur
dialogues.text: Home of the Windborne... What do you think of that?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Surely the song should at least mention Lord Barbatos...?
